integration.reason: Reuse the reviewed behavior as an adapter specification; keep H3 Studio profiles, receipts, asset paths, auth and origin checks as the production boundary.

optional_models.activation_gate: Pin an independently licensed artifact digest, verify ComfyUI compatibility and pass VRAM, cancellation and rollback acceptance before exposing Refine.

optional_python_packages.reason: NVIDIA RTX VSR only; proprietary, driver-specific and not required for the H3 Studio baseline.

dependencies.production_policy: Resolve and hash-lock transitive packages in an isolated release environment; never pip-install into the live current release.

forbidden_routes.risk: No H3 Studio upload quota, chunk-count cap or TTL contract.
Bypasses receipt-based media identifiers and path containment.
Bypasses authenticated asset and bounded media-processing contracts.
Client-controlled LLM endpoint and credentials can create SSRF and secret-forwarding exposure.
The entire upstream namespace remains deny-by-default; templates must be versioned in H3 Studio.
Client-controlled LLM egress and hidden prompt mutation are outside the H3 Studio prompt contract.
Bypasses receipt-based path containment, media limits and derivation receipts.
Can expose local media bytes outside the authenticated asset API.

steps: Create a new immutable H3 Studio release and isolated Python environment.
Clone the upstream repository and checkout the exact locked commit; reject a dirty tree or a different HEAD.
Resolve and hash-lock dependencies, then install only into the staged release.
Verify the five required model filenames and separately approved model licenses and digests without downloading them automatically.
Keep the optional latent upscaler and nvidia-vfx disabled until their separate acceptance gates pass.
Block every forbidden route at the H3 Studio gateway and verify internal ComfyUI is not browser reachable.
Run contract, unit, build, dry-run workflow and capability tests before any paid GPU canary.
Switch the current release symlink only after acceptance and retain the previous release.

rollback.data_root_policy: Shared assets, jobs and receipts stay outside immutable releases and are not rewritten by plugin installation.
trigger_conditions: GPU OOM, cancellation or output-integrity failure
steps: Stop only the staged or newly promoted Studio and ComfyUI processes.
Restore the previous current-release symlink and the prior pinned Profile manifest.
Restart services and verify health, capabilities, assets, jobs, thumbnails and Range downloads.
Preserve failed-release logs and receipts; do not delete or migrate shared user data.
Remove the failed immutable release only after evidence is archived and no process references it.
